Hero.title: Data engineering
Hero.description: I build and lead production data systems, and my specialty is the data engineering behind research — the Airflow, DuckDB and PostGIS pipelines that turn open spatial data into papers. The research seat is urban dynamics: gentrification, accessibility, housing markets — because cities are where data problems get hard. The pipelines behind my papers are public repositories.

About.publicationsEmpty: Papers land here as they publish.
About.expertiseSubtitle: Five competences, one constraint: a calibrated pipeline tends to outlast a clever one.
About.educationSubtitle: AI as an undergraduate, data science and analytics as a graduate — the methods side of the toolkit. The production side came from work.
About.experienceSubtitle: 5+ years building and leading production data systems — pipelines, forecasting, geospatial — across European markets and academic research.
About.lede1: Based in Amsterdam, I lead data teams and build what they run: big-data pipelines, forecasting and nowcasting models, network analysis and spatial data products. The craft underneath is system design: the architecture is what decides whether a pipeline is still running in its third year. The research seat stays warm — urban dynamics, gentrification, accessibility at parcel resolution — because cities are where data problems get hard. A geodata specialist by depth; a data lead by trade.
About.lede2: My bias: opinionated internal tools beat big platforms; a calibrated pipeline beats a clever one; and a map should answer a question, not perform complexity.
About.factBasisValue: Amsterdam, Netherlands · Dutch, English, German, Italian

expertise.title: Data Architecture & Pipelines
expertise.description: Scrape and ETL infrastructure that keeps running: three years of weekly collection across 8 authenticated sources, 250k+ records — schema, orchestration and failure handling designed up front, Airflow and PostGIS underneath.

expertise.title: Network Science
expertise.description: Graph methods on real geographies — a saturation-validated Connectivity Score at parcel resolution, accessibility and connectivity research.

expertise.title: Timeseries & Forecasting
expertise.description: A monthly house-price index across 13 EU countries tested with Eurostat, plus nowcasting models for sparse, slow official statistics.

expertise.title: Spatial Analysis & Simulation
expertise.description: Parcel- and postcode-level modelling and simulation: agent-based gentrification models, hedonic pricing, H3 and PostGIS as daily tools.

expertise.title: Product Ownership & Leadership
expertise.description: End-to-end ownership from method to shipped API — a 13-server build, and a team of 4–5 led at KR&A.

experience.description: Leading data strategy, a team of 4–5 and AI initiatives for an alternative-data FinTech serving European real-estate funds, assets and REITs. Led the aggregation pipeline homogenising listings across 13 EU countries and the Connectivity Score build — 13 servers, on budget, two weeks ahead of plan.

Built ML models for property valuation and market analysis across 15+ European markets; work delivered for real-estate companies, pension funds and Eurostat. Includes a monthly house-price index across 13 EU countries, tested as a disaggregation indicator for Eurostat quarterly HPIs.
Delivered a thesis predicting flooding occurrences in Europe using alternative data and ML models — 90%+ accuracy in risk classification.
Maintained enterprise-grade digital declaration software part-time, delivering features built with EmberJS, PHP and sensitive customer data, under CI/CD and testing.

Author.bio: I lead data teams and build production data systems in Amsterdam. This site collects the case studies, papers and field notes.

AboutTeaser.bio1: Geodata engineer and urban-dynamics researcher, based in Amsterdam. Head of Data at KR&A. MSc in Data Science & Business Analytics from Bocconi; BSc in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Amsterdam, roughly five years between the two, spent mostly on the production side.
AboutTeaser.bio2: I work at the intersection of geospatial analytics, ML and the data infrastructure that makes both useful, the pipelines, schemas and spatial joins that do not appear in papers but determine whether the model ships. This site collects what is worth writing down: papers, methods, tools and the occasional strong opinion on why dashboards are overrated.
